Destination Guide

Explore Afghanistan by region, province, and travel hub.

Browse Afghanistan through the way travel actually works: broad regions, individual provinces, operational cities and hubs, and the food and culture that gives each journey context.
Regions Provinces Cities & Hubs Food & Culture

Regions

Start with Afghanistan’s major travel regions.

Regions help travelers understand scale, climate, route logic, and broad cultural geography.

Region

Central Afghanistan

Kabul, Bamyan, Panjshir, Parwan, Wardak, Ghazni, and the highland routes at the heart of many cultural journeys.

Region

North Afghanistan

Balkh, Mazar-e-Sharif, Samangan, Baghlan, Kunduz, Takhar, Faryab, Jowzjan, and Sar-e-Pol.

Region

West Afghanistan

Herat, Ghor, Badghis, and Farah: Timurid architecture, Silk Road history, and rugged western routes.

Region

East Afghanistan

Nangarhar, Laghman, Kunar, Nuristan, Khost, Paktia, Paktika, and eastern mountain corridors.

Region

South Afghanistan

Kandahar, Helmand, Uruzgan, Zabul, and Nimroz: Durrani history, desert routes, and southern cultural sites.

Region

Wakhan & Northeast

Badakhshan, Faizabad, Wakhan access, mountain expeditions, river valleys, and remote frontier routes.
